text: Why SIPROTEC 5 Compact – Universal protection relay?

The SIPROTEC 5 Compact (7SX800) is a versatile, high-performance solution for protecting feeders, lines, and motors in medium-voltage systems. Combining protection, automation, and monitoring in one compact device, it reduces complexity and costs while ensuring maximum reliability. With intuitive operation, advanced cybersecurity, and future-ready design, SIPROTEC 5 Compact delivers proven Siemens quality for efficient and secure power system management.
